description: Walenstadt sits at the east end of Walensee, and the frame looks from the town shore toward the dark wall of the Churfirsten. The Open-Meteo model is mainly clear and mild, about 14°C, with cloud cover about 5%, humid air, a light wind, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
